description: 新北市加油站清冊-三重區 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府經濟發展局. 提供本市加油站營業主體、加油站站名、地址等資料。 (三重區). Coverage: 新北市政府經濟發展局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府經濟發展局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
